name: ruflo-chatgpt-federation
description: Dedicated ChatGPT Federation MCP publisher with isolated Nostr signing-key custody, OAuth-scoped publishing, and signed public-channel coordination over the Ruflo relay. As a mod (ADR-445 pattern): a tighten-only tool guard, a local slash command, and a status file the console shows.

guard.title: Tool guard
guard.description: Refuse clearly harmful calls to this plugin's tools (tighten-only: it can only deny, never allow).

maxPayloadBytes.title: Max publish payload (bytes)
maxPayloadBytes.description: Refuse channel_publish payloads larger than this, 256 to 65536.
